title: Occupational Certificate: Occupational Trainer
purpose: The purpose of this qualification is to prepare a learner to operate as an Occupational Trainer. This qualification aims to prepare learners to establish learner profiles, identify special needs, and address barriers to learning within specified training program requirements. Learners will prepare, adapt, and align learning materials and resources for workplace training interventions, demonstrate relevant interpersonal skills and employ appropriate facilitation techniques, review and report on the quality and effectiveness of their training, and meet documentation and administrative requirements.
rationale: This qualification is designed to equip learners with the skills necessary to plan, prepare, coordinate, implement, and evaluate learning programs, ensuring occupational trainee competence. It provides the foundation for effective workplace training and development, ensuring that trainers have the necessary competencies to design, deliver, and assess training programs that meet industry standards and learner needs.
exitLevelOutcomes: Establish learner profiles, special needs, and barriers to learning
Prepare, adapt, and align learning materials and resources for workplace training interventions
Demonstrate relevant interpersonal skills and employ appropriate facilitation techniques
Review and report on the quality and effectiveness of training
Meet documentation and administrative requirements
Plan, schedule, and conduct competence evaluations within their area of expertise
Perform assessment/evaluation administration and provide appropriate feedback to learners

title: Occupational Certificate: Financial Advisor
purpose: The purpose of this qualification is to prepare a learner to operate as a Financial Advisor. A Financial Advisor analyses the financial needs of clients and facilitates processes to implement solutions that will contribute towards the protection and growth of wealth for clients.
rationale: The qualification caters for building competence at Levels 5 and 6. There are three-part qualifications enabling the development of new entrants into the occupation and then catering for the further development as the employees specialise and eventually grow to become fully fledged Financial Advisors. The effective use of wealth creation tools to grow wealth is essential for the protection and wellbeing of citizens. This industry provides an essential service in support of the development of the country and the achievement of the National Development Plan's objectives.
exitLevelOutcomes: Provide advice to clients regarding the use of Long Term Insurance to manage risks and protect wealth
Provide advice to clients regarding the implementation of Employee benefits and Retirement Funds
Provide advice regarding the use of Health Care benefit programmes
Provide advice to clients to grow and protect wealth through appropriate Investments and related methods
